title: tylophora ovata var. balansae
intro: Tylophora ovata var. balansae, commonly known as Balan's Tylophora, is a plant species belonging to the family Apocynaceae. It is a traditional medicinal plant in Southeast Asia, known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimalarial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tylophora ovata var. balansae include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory and cardiovascular diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
